data: train100 only from runs/reveals/tiger-200.jsonl; test100 not evaluated
selection_rule: require posterior support >= broad baseline; find best posterior mean logloss; select lowest mean effective curated fraction among candidates within one paired whole-battle SE of best loss
tie_break: lower global cap, then lower marginal-drift cap, then candidate name
paired_se: ratio-estimator cluster SE: sqrt(B/(B-1)*sum_b[n_b*(d_b-delta)]^2)/N; labels weighted equally, resampling unit whole battle
guardrail: EV/nature/item/move/Tera marginal drift caps fixed before scores; never relax to optimize EV-blind likelihood
